H2_calibration.quote: an aggressive reading of the safety-evaluation exemption or of splitting runs could damage credibility at the markup.

H1_holdback.quote: pointing them out may prompt tightening amendments, such as aggregation of compute across runs, anti-splitting language, and foreign-affiliate coverage. Counsel should consider which points to raise publicly and which to raise only with staff.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: a run could be initiated shortly before enactment to lock in the exemption, and successor or updated models might be argued to share a training start date.
